title: PaperWalls (com.herojoneslabs.paperwalls)
description: Managed preferences for the PaperWalls wallpaper manager. Only keys you add to the payload are forced; every omitted key stays user-editable in the app. Forced keys appear disabled in the app with a 'Managed by your organization' badge.

selectedWallpaperID.title: Selected Wallpaper
selectedWallpaperID.description: Wallpaper ID to pin: a bundled ID (e.g. bundled-aurora-veil), a folder-wallpaper content ID (file:<hash>, shown in the app's Settings as 'Selected Wallpaper ID'; identical on every Mac with the same image file — legacy external-<hash> IDs still resolve), or an absolute file path.

scale.title: Scaling Mode
scale.description: How the wallpaper is fitted to the screen.

fillColor.title: Fill Color
fillColor.description: Optional letterbox color as a 6-digit hex value (e.g. 1D2E3F), used with Fit and Center scaling.

applyToAllScreens.title: Apply to All Displays
applyToAllScreens.description: When enabled, 'manage' and the app set every attached display; when disabled, only the primary display.

lockMode.title: Lock Mode
lockMode.description: Lock tier. off: no lock. soft: only the Selected Wallpaper can be applied; Set/Next/Rotate grey out; paperwallscli set refuses (exit 6). hard: nothing can be applied, no exit from the locked view — pair with the Tier-2 OS lock profile (the app detects and reports whether the OS restriction is present). enforcedRotation: rotation continues within Allowed Wallpaper IDs only.

options.infoText: Key: lockMode (default: off). Supersedes the legacy lockSelection bool, which still maps to soft/hard.

lockSelection.title: Lock Wallpaper Selection (Legacy)
lockSelection.description: Legacy single-tier lock; superseded by Lock Mode. true maps to soft (or hard when a forced allowLockExit=false is also present). Prefer Lock Mode for new profiles.

allowLockExit.title: Allow Exiting the Locked View
allowLockExit.description: Only relevant with Lock Wallpaper Selection. Enabled: users may leave the locked screen and browse the library read-only. Disabled: hard lock — the full-screen locked view cannot be exited.

allowedWallpaperIDs.title: Allowed Wallpaper IDs
allowedWallpaperIDs.description: Optional allow-list. When present and non-empty, the app only shows (and rotation only uses) wallpapers with these IDs, across all sources.

externalWallpaperFolderPath.title: Managed Wallpaper Folder
externalWallpaperFolderPath.description: Absolute path to the organization's wallpaper folder (e.g. /Library/CompanyWallpapers), scanned non-recursively for .jpg/.jpeg/.png/.heic/.tiff. Surfaces as the read-only 'Managed' source. Deploy the images separately.

companyName.title: Company Name
companyName.description: Organization branding. Replaces the generic 'Company'/'Managed' wording: the sidebar shows '<Name> (Managed)', the Browse filter shows '<Name>', the org feed shows '<Name> Feed'.

showBundledWallpapers.title: Show Bundled Wallpapers
showBundledWallpapers.description: When disabled, the app-bundled curated set (and the Collections page) is hidden; only folder sources appear.

showSystemWallpapers.title: Show macOS Wallpapers
showSystemWallpapers.description: Shows Apple's built-in wallpapers (/System/Library/Desktop Pictures, flat images only) as the 'macOS' source in the app.

allowSystemWallpaperDownloads.title: Allow macOS Wallpaper Downloads
allowSystemWallpaperDownloads.description: Permits fetching not-yet-downloaded Apple built-in wallpapers on demand from Apple's CDN (updates.cdn-apple.com) when the user clicks Download. Force false on network-restricted fleets — the 'Available to download' section disappears.

showFeaturedWallpaper.title: Show 'Featured Today' Hero
showFeaturedWallpaper.description: Shows or hides the daily featured wallpaper banner at the top of Browse.

appCuratedEnabled.title: Enable PaperWalls Curated Feed
appCuratedEnabled.description: Downloads the PaperWalls-curated wallpaper feed (Ed25519-signed manifest, sha256-verified assets, cached locally). When false the app makes no network requests for this source.

orgCatalogEnabled.title: Enable Organization Feed
orgCatalogEnabled.description: Enables a remote wallpaper feed hosted by your organization. Requires Organization Feed URL and Organization Feed Public Key; the feed stays off until both are set.

orgCatalogURL.title: Organization Feed URL
orgCatalogURL.description: HTTPS URL of the organization's catalog.json (manifest v2). The Ed25519 signature is fetched from the same URL with .sig appended.

orgCatalogPublicKey.title: Organization Feed Public Key
orgCatalogPublicKey.description: Base64-encoded raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key used to verify the organization feed's manifest signature.

personalFolderSource.title: Personal Folder Mode
personalFolderSource.description: Where the Personal source draws from: the fixed app-managed library (~/Library/Application Support/PaperWalls/Personal/, images added by drag-and-drop) or a user-defined folder path (personalWallpaperFolderPath). Unset: Macs with a personal folder path already configured stay user-defined; fresh Macs get app-managed.

options.infoText: Key: personalFolderSource (default: appManaged, with legacy fallback)

personalWallpaperFolderPath.title: Personal Wallpaper Folder
personalWallpaperFolderPath.description: The user's own wallpaper folder ('Personal' source). Usually left to the user; force it only to standardize or disable the personal source.

favoriteWallpaperIDs.title: Favorite Wallpaper IDs
favoriteWallpaperIDs.description: The user's hearted wallpapers. Usually left to the user; forcing this pins the Favorites list.

autoRotateEnabled.title: Auto-Rotate Wallpaper
autoRotateEnabled.description: Automatically cycle the desktop through a source while the app or its menu bar item is running.

autoRotateIntervalMinutes.title: Rotation Interval (Minutes)
autoRotateIntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between automatic changes. The app's Settings offers 5, 15, 30, 60, and 1440 (daily); any positive integer works.

rotationPool.title: Rotation Pool
rotationPool.description: Sources auto-rotate draws from. Members: favorites, bundled, system, appCurated, orgRemote, orgFolder, personal. 'favorites' narrows the pick to hearted wallpapers; an empty array means nothing rotates (current wallpaper is kept). Replaces the legacy autoRotateSource and rotateInclude* keys (still honored and translated when this key is absent).

autoRotateSource.title: Rotation Source (Legacy)
autoRotateSource.description: LEGACY - migrated into rotationPool; still honored when rotationPool is not set. What auto-rotate draws from: the user's favorites, all enabled sources, or only the managed company folder.

autoRotateShuffle.title: Shuffle Order
autoRotateShuffle.description: Pick randomly instead of cycling in order.

autoRotateOnWake.title: Change on Wake
autoRotateOnWake.description: Apply a new wallpaper each time the Mac wakes.

rotateIncludeBundled.title: Rotation Includes Bundled Wallpapers (Legacy)
rotateIncludeBundled.description: LEGACY - migrated into rotationPool; still honored when rotationPool is not set. Bundled set participates when Rotation Source is 'All wallpapers'.

rotateIncludePersonal.title: Rotation Includes Personal Folder (Legacy)
rotateIncludePersonal.description: LEGACY - migrated into rotationPool; still honored when rotationPool is not set. Personal folder participates when Rotation Source is 'All wallpapers'.

rotateIncludeManaged.title: Rotation Includes Managed Folder (Legacy)
rotateIncludeManaged.description: LEGACY - migrated into rotationPool; still honored when rotationPool is not set. Managed folder participates when Rotation Source is 'All wallpapers'.

appearanceTheme.title: Window Theme
appearanceTheme.description: Appearance for the PaperWalls window and menu bar panel: light, dark, or follow the macOS system setting.

gridColumns.title: Grid Columns
gridColumns.description: Wallpaper grid density: 2, 3, or 4 columns. Usually a user choice via the header view control; forceable like any key.

screenSaverEnabled.title: Screen Saver Enabled
screenSaverEnabled.description: Master switch for the PaperWalls screen saver. When disabled, the saver shows a solid color and nothing else.

activeScreenSaverSceneID.title: Active Screen Saver
activeScreenSaverSceneID.description: The scene the PaperWalls screen saver runs: the ID of a scene in the user's library (a UUID), or 'managed' for the scene provisioned with Managed Screen Saver Scene. Forcing this key disables 'Set Active' in the app.

managedScreenSaverScene.title: Managed Screen Saver Scene
managedScreenSaverScene.description: An organization-provided scene, as JSON. It appears in every user's ScreenSavers page as a read-only 'Managed' entry with the ID 'managed'. Build the scene in PaperWalls Studio, then use the card's 'Copy Scene for MDM' action and paste the result here.

allowedScreenSaverSceneIDs.title: Allowed Screen Saver IDs
allowedScreenSaverSceneIDs.description: Optional allow-list of scene IDs that may be the active screen saver (use 'managed' for the managed scene). Empty or omitted allows every scene. Scenes outside the list stay visible in the library but cannot be set active.

allowScreenSaverCreation.title: Allow Creating Screen Savers
allowScreenSaverCreation.description: When disabled, users cannot create, edit, rename, or delete screen savers, and Studio's ScreenSaver tab is unavailable. They can still browse, preview, and set active among the allowed scenes.

adminModeEnabled.title: Admin Mode
adminModeEnabled.description: Enables the admin tools: Studio's Package tab (build an installer package of screen savers for deployment) and the Copy Scene for MDM card action. Leave disabled (or force false) on end-user Macs.

showScreenSaversPage.title: Show ScreenSavers Page
showScreenSaversPage.description: Shows or hides the ScreenSavers page in the sidebar's Library section.

showStudio.title: Show Studio
showStudio.description: Shows or hides Studio (the sidebar's Tools section) entirely.

showStudioWallpapersTab.title: Show Studio Wallpapers Tab
showStudioWallpapersTab.description: Shows or hides Studio's Wallpapers tab (currently a 'coming soon' placeholder). If both Studio tabs are hidden, Studio is hidden.

showStudioScreenSaverTab.title: Show Studio ScreenSaver Tab
showStudioScreenSaverTab.description: Shows or hides Studio's ScreenSaver tab (the Scene Composer). If both Studio tabs are hidden, Studio is hidden.
